cases.sentence: Распахни свои двери, Ливан, пусть ___ пожрет твои кедры.
cases.translation: Open your doors, Lebanon, that the fire may devour your cedars.
cases.explain: Огонь is the subject of the verb пожрет (will devour), so it takes the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Слышен ___ пастухов, их богатые выгоны разорены.
cases.translation: A voice of the wailing of the shepherds!
cases.explain: Плач is the subject of слышен (is heard), taking nominative case.

cases.translation: I cut off the three shepherds in one month.
cases.explain: Time expressions with за use the accusative case: за месяц (for a month).

cases.sentence: И они отвесили мне тридцать шекелей ___.
cases.translation: So they weighed for my wages thirty pieces of silver.
cases.explain: In expressions of quantity, the material noun takes the genitive: шекелей серебра (pieces of silver).

cases.sentence: Я взял тридцать шекелей серебра и бросил их в доме Господнем для ___.
cases.translation: I took the thirty pieces of silver, and threw them to the potter.
cases.explain: The preposition для (for) always governs the genitive case.

cases.sentence: Я сломал второй посох, разорвав узы братства между Иудой и ___.
cases.translation: Then I cut apart my other staff, even Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
cases.explain: The preposition между (between) governs the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Господь сказал мне, брось их к ___.
cases.translation: Yahweh said to me, throw it to the potter.
cases.explain: The preposition к (to) governs the dative case.

cases.sentence: Пусть рука его совсем иссохнет и правый ___ совершенно ослепнет.
cases.translation: His arm will be completely withered, and his right eye will be totally blinded!
cases.explain: Глаз is the subject of the verb ослепнет (will be blinded), taking nominative case.

reading.ru: Плачь, Кипарис, потому что рухнул кедр, погибли величественные деревья.
reading.question: What does the cypress tree mourn in this verse?
options: The fall of the cedar and destruction of stately trees
reading.correct: The fall of the cedar and destruction of stately trees
reading.explain: The verse directly states that the cypress weeps because the cedar has fallen.

reading.ru: Слышен плач пастухов, их богатые выгоны разорены.
reading.question: What happened to the shepherds' pastures?
options: They have been destroyed and devastated
They have been sold to other nations
They are being abandoned by the sheep
reading.correct: They have been destroyed and devastated
reading.explain: The text says их богатые выгоны разорены — their rich pastures are ruined.

reading.ru: Я пас беднейших овец Атары, обреченных на убой.
reading.question: What is the condition of the sheep?
options: Destined for slaughter and the poorest of the flock
reading.correct: Destined for slaughter and the poorest of the flock
reading.explain: The text explicitly states he pastured the poorest sheep destined for slaughter.

reading.ru: Я взял два посоха и назвал один благоволением, а другой — единством.
reading.question: What were the names of the two staffs?
reading.explain: The verse states он назвал один благоволением, а другой — единством.

reading.ru: Я взял мой посох, называвшийся благоволением, и сломал его, расторгнув завет.
reading.question: What did the shepherd do with his staff called Favor?
options: Broke it, breaking his covenant with all nations
Gave it to the people as a sign of blessing
Used it to gather the scattered sheep
reading.correct: Broke it, breaking his covenant with all nations
reading.explain: The text says I took my staff Favor, and cut it apart.

reading.ru: Они отвесили мне тридцать шекелей серебра.
reading.question: What amount of silver was given as payment?
reading.explain: The text clearly states они отвесили мне тридцать шекелей серебра.
